shared_elements: bearded male human figure in profile
hair and beard rendered as regular rows of tight curls
low-relief figure facing right (or left) in strict profile with frontal-ish eye convention
justification: Both show bearded men in strict profile low relief with soft caps and hair/beard treated as tidy repeating rows of curls, plus attention to patterned dress — a fairly specific shared figural convention. But A is a single monumental bust filling the field, while B is a horizontal processional frieze with a large camel, staff- and vessel-bearing attendants and a rosette border, none of which recurs in A.
